name: Charter Thickend
description: Dropping low behind the club, the student faces a shield with the club held ready to strike its face.

name: Ravaging Girth
description: A straight drive of the club's end hammers the central boss of an enemy shield.

name: Handholdgrip Fastness
description: The knob hooks the shield's rim and drags it aside, opening the holder's body to the next blow.

name: Might Thump
description: A diagonal step takes the student round the shield's edge and onto the unguarded side.

name: Rumbleclout
description: Qi from the opened meridians pours into the club and the hammer blow numbs the arm holding the shield.

name: Dominating Clout
description: The club is wedged under the shield's lower edge and levered up, tearing the brace from its holder.

name: Furrowing Burl Maelstrom
description: All the meridians' qi is driven into one blow that shatters a shield's boards and jars the arm behind.

name: Scalding Cudgel
description: After qi is gathered, a sweeping swing knocks every raised shield in the front rank out of line.

name: Hardened Stout
description: Feet sunk deep and body upright, the student stands like a trunk against pushing and glancing blows.

name: Bulgebarrage
description: The club falls along the line of the body's muscle grain rather than across it, like a log-splitter's stroke.

name: Gust Bulge
description: Lifted high with both hands, the club comes down in one straight stroke onto the opponent's guard.

name: Torrent Bludgeon
description: Close to the opponent's flank, the student brushes past on a quick sidestep while staying rooted.

name: Intent Heartwood
description: Qi rises from the soles up the spine and into the club's grain, adding weight to the next strokes.

name: Might Knob
description: The club's narrow end is driven like a wedge between a foe's guard arms, forcing them apart.

name: Drubbing Wallop
description: A sweeping, level stroke crosses the opponent's front like a bough in the wind and bowls him over.

name: Wallopthrash
description: The qi-filled club comes down like a felling blow, driving the opponent's frame toward the ground.

name: Belabor Onslaught
description: Qi gathered along the grain is released through one blow, sending shock through the body.

name: Charter Roundhead
description: Held back at a measured distance, the student studies the opponent's armour for seams and weak plates.

name: Burlassault
description: A heavy straight blow on the breastplate rocks the wearer and presses the metal against his ribs.

name: Sanguine Bellyswell
description: A swing against the side of a helm rings it and dizzies the head inside.

name: Sanguine Bludgeon
description: A low blow to the shin armour dents it inward onto the bone beneath.

name: Gustgirth
description: A circling step finds the armpit or the back of the knee, where plates part.

name: Glint Belabor
description: Qi carried in the club passes through a mail shirt and quakes the flesh beneath it.

name: Granite Stout
description: Repeated pounding drives the club's weight through a thick padded coat to the muscle under it.

name: Chime Bulge
description: The club's tip is jammed into the hinge of an elbow or knee plate and the joint is twisted.

name: Rumblethump
description: Full-meridian qi sends the blow's shock straight through a cuirass, crushing the chest it covers.

name: Girth Cuirass
description: Rapid blows on the plates set up a jarring shake that robs the wearer of sense and balance.

name: Girthplating
description: Planted with the feet wide, the student holds the club ready to answer several attackers.

name: Rumble Burl
description: A long level swing at the hip sweeps into the nearest opponent's side.

name: Might Bellyswell
description: A forward step carries the full body behind an overhand pound onto the crown.

name: Torrent Knob
description: The club is swung backward under the arm to knock aside a blow from behind.

name: Granite Thump
description: Steady circling paces keep each of several foes on the student's front or flank, never at his back.

name: Iron Thickend
description: The butt end of the haft drives backward into the stomach of a man closing from behind.

name: Lambasting Cudgel
description: Qi spreads from the body as the club is swung all the way round, striking at once those within reach.

name: Doctrine Clout
description: The club rebounds from one foe straight into the next, linking three blows in one flowing line.

name: Iron Roundhead
description: Pausing with the club braced across the body, the student soaks several blows without moving.

name: Mayhemwallop
description: A great swing, charged by field-driven qi, strikes every opponent around the student in one sweep.

name: Transfixing Clout
description: A ceaseless flow of club strokes keeps the surrounding foes pinned and unable to press in.

name: Steadfast Stout
description: The cudgel is held in a double grip, one hand for the body track and one for the qi track.

name: Iron Heartwood
description: Two knocks in quick pair strike the same spot, the second driving in what the first loosened.

name: Gust Roundhead
description: A crack to the left shoulder is followed at once by a crack to the right hip.

name: Belabor Spurt
description: Foot and cudgel move together in matched time, so no step opens the student's guard.

name: Chimeknob
description: Two deflections run side by side along the cudgel, turning a thrust past each shoulder.

name: Handholdgrip Hauberk
description: The cudgel catches both of the opponent's wrists in a hooked pair and pulls them apart.

name: Scorching Girth
description: A pounding blow carried by muscle alone lands first to set the target before qi follows.

name: Facet Cudgel
description: A narrow thread of qi runs down the cudgel and thrusts through the guard like a lance.

name: Gust Burl
description: Body and qi blows alternate in two rhythms, so the opponent cannot time his block to either.

name: Unshaken Bulge
description: A parry on one side is mirrored at once by a strike on the other.

name: Thumptorment
description: Body-track weight and qi-track force meet at the club's head, and the double blow lands as one.

name: Rumblecudgel
description: Two shocks follow the same path inside the body, the second finishing what the first began.

name: Aegis Heartwood
description: Standing tall on one leg with the cudgel cocked high, the student watches for an opening.

name: Sanguine Handholdgrip
description: A quick clawing downward rap with the cudgel's end catches the hand or the brow.

name: Torrent Thickend
description: Arms spread like wings, the student hops aside to dodge a charge.

name: Iron Thump
description: The cudgel's tip stabs forward at face height like a beak, forcing the head back.

name: Knob Canter
description: Qi in the legs launches a leaping dive that crosses the gap from above and ahead.

name: Toxin Bellyswell
description: Hooking the cudgel's knob in a collar, the student drags the quarry down by his own weight.

name: Lancing Bludgeon Thrash
description: Dropping from a leap with the whole body behind the cudgel, the student strikes like a hawk on its prey.

name: Burlthrash
description: Wheeling around the quarry, the student lands a swift series of raps from every side.

name: Enduring Knob
description: Feet set in a wide, curved line like a basin's rim, the student gathers weight in the middle.

name: Skinning Handholdgrip
description: Breath is held low in the belly, then released through a short, dense club stroke.

name: Blazeclout
description: The club's weight spills over the top of its arc and swings down heavy and flat.

name: Bludgeon Pounce
description: The student walks in a gentle curve, like a river bending, and ends beside the opponent.

name: Heartwood Cloak
description: A broad, low parry skims a strike across the club like a stone across shallows.

name: Subduing Clout
description: The club presses steadily on the foe while qi collects in it like water filling a pool.

name: Knobthrash
description: Gathered qi is let go all at once through the club and spills into the target.

name: Facetknob
description: With breath calm and club level, the student's guard stays smooth and takes a blow without ripple.

name: Bulge Torment
description: Qi is gathered until it overflows, and the full brimming force is struck out in one crushing blow.

name: Mayhemstout
description: The club sweeps out a flood of qi that knocks aside everything in its low, wide path.

name: Ironburl
description: The hands are set apart so that two separate lines of force run down the club.

name: Blazethump
description: A turning swing that circles like an eddy lands where the opponent's guard has just left.

name: Siltgirth
description: Close along the opponent's flank like a stream along its bank, the student skims past unhit.

name: Burlplating
description: The club crosses an attack's path at an angle, like a current crossing another, and diverts it.

name: Girthelixir
description: One current of qi is pushed up from the legs against the other, building pressure in the club.

name: Rumble Wallop
description: A current runs the other way, pulling the opponent's weapon along and out of his grip.

name: Rupturing Roundhead
description: The two currents of qi meet at the club's head and break against the target together.

name: Blaze Bellyswell
description: Both currents surge down the club in step, and the smash lands with twice the shock.

name: Thorn Girth
description: The currents spin round the club in a whirlpool that draws the opponent's limbs in and holds them.

name: Facet Burl
description: Turned to face the wind, the student leans into it with the cudgel low and the weight forward.

name: Gust Wallop
description: A plain overhand stroke falls on the breath of an oath spoken aloud, with nothing held back.

name: Gust Cudgel
description: A rap as sudden as a gust lands on the wrist before the opponent has finished his draw.

name: Might Stout
description: The student steps to the sheltered side of the opponent's attack, where its force has run out.

name: Chime Thickend
description: The cudgel meets a strike side-on, as a crosswind meets a flame, and bends it away.

name: Wrecking Bulge
description: A jab with the cudgel's tip, quick and hard as the front of a gale, strikes the breastbone.

name: Belabor Greave
description: The cudgel's shaft drives into the opponent's chest with a shove of qi like a plateau wind.

name: Mightburl
description: The cudgel is whirled until it whistles, and its qi-sharpened arc cracks against the target.

name: Unbroken Bellyswell
description: A cushion of qi shaped like a held breath of wind slows each blow before the cudgel meets it.

name: Blaze Handholdgrip
description: An oath is spoken and the wind answers, adding its push to a hammer blow of the cudgel.

name: Paralyzing Roundhead
description: A low sweep drives a gale of qi along the ground, tearing every foe's footing away.

name: Hoarfrost Heartwood
description: Heels near an unseen drop, the student plants his weight and refuses to give any ground.

name: Paralyzing Thump
description: The club's shaft shoves the opponent toward the edge of his footing.

name: Drubbing Thickend
description: A short, hard chop falls like a stone off the rim onto the opponent's shoulder.

name: Whipping Girth
description: On narrow or broken ground, each step is placed with care and the club stays level.

name: Chimegirth
description: A parry that turns the strike back toward the attacker's own open side.

name: Hamstringing Knob
description: The student grips the ground with his toes and hauls the opponent forward with the club's knob.

name: Might Wallop
description: A qi-backed blow drives the opponent back a full pace toward the edge behind him.

name: Stout Fastness
description: With one heel set firm and qi sunk into it, the student holds against a strong rush.

name: Bludgeon Hauberk
description: The club leans on the foe and qi pushes like a steady gale, pinning him backward.

name: Granite Clout
description: A heavy swing is thrown so hard that it would crack a stone ledge, and the foe is flung.

name: Tempered Wallop
description: With the field of qi pinning him to the spot, the student's hammerfall leaves the opponent no way to give.

name: Blazewallop
description: A broad swing sends out a wave of qi that pushes every foe in front back off his footing.

name: Unbroken Thickend
description: The student speaks a short oath, sets his feet, and holds the club still until the first blow.

name: Ironstout
description: A line is taken on the opponent's centre, and the club follows it without wavering.

name: Rumblestout
description: A rap along the held line of the bearing lands exactly where the student had aimed.

name: Torrent Belabor
description: The student advances along his bearing, never swerving, however the opponent moves.

name: Unbroken Burl
description: A parry that holds its line no matter how hard the blow, trusting the oath to hold the arm.

name: Cudgelthrash
description: Qi gathers in the club behind a promise made aloud, and the blow falls heavy and true.

name: Bulgeplating
description: The club is held on a true line to the opponent's eyes, and attacks break against it.

name: Compressing Knob
description: A shove from the side pushes the opponent off the line he has taken and spoils his aim.

name: Thump Maelstrom
description: The oath is kept in a single blow that falls on the sworn target with the whole body's weight.

name: Blazestout
description: Holding the bearing while turning, the student sweeps one continuous stroke through everything on the line.

name: Implacable Bulge
description: Squared into a strong wind, the student lets it press on the body while the club stays steady.

name: Blazegirth
description: With the wind at his back, an overhand stroke falls faster than the arm alone could swing it.

name: Silt Wallop
description: The student keeps his course across a buffeting wind, one even step after another.

name: Torrent Burl
description: A parry thrown with a sudden side gust of the body knocks the strike off its mark.

name: Might Roundhead
description: A deep breath drawn against the wind gathers its force into the qi that fills the club.

name: Granite Handholdgrip
description: Running before the wind, the student's club arrives with the gale's push behind it.

name: Facet Girth
description: Against a headwind or a rush, the club braces on the ground and the student leans on it.

name: Belabor Barrage
description: The cudgel falls with the full weight of the gale and the field of qi driving it down.

name: Scalding Bellyswell
description: A great swing gathers the storm's edge into the club and sweeps it across all in front.
